name: Physical solvent gas treating (Selexol, Rectisol, Purisol)
applications: separate H2S and CO2 streams for sulfur recovery and CO2 storage or EOR
principle: Acid gases dissolve in an organic solvent in proportion to their partial pressure, with no chemical reaction. The rich solvent is released by pressure letdown, flashing and, where H2S must be sent to sulfur recovery, heat or stripping gas, so regeneration needs less heat than amine. Selexol uses dimethyl ethers of polyethylene glycol; Rectisol uses refrigerated methanol. Because capacity rises with pressure, physical solvents suit high-pressure gas such as gasification syngas and not low-pressure gas.

process_steps.name: Feed gas cooling and water removal
Acid gas absorption at high pressure
Staged flash of rich solvent (CO2 release, recycle of co-absorbed hydrocarbons)
Acid gas to sulfur recovery or CO2 handling
